h: 这是我为 Flux 制作的最喜欢的工作流程。它有一个电源 lora 节点，您可以在其中添加任意数量的 LoRA。我有一个 Nvidia RTX 4090 24gig，我可以在 7 秒内制作一张图像。

o.en: This is my favorite workflow that I made for Flux. It has a power lora node where you can add as many LoRA's as you choose. I have an Nvidia RTX 4090 24gig and I can craft an image in 7 seconds.
